description: Deletion test. The module carries two layers that only forward their arguments; a cleanup must merge them away rather than keep or rename them.
rubric: The input has three functions that fetch a user row: `_query_user_row`, `_load_user` and `get_user`. Two of them only forward their arguments. PASS only if the revised module leaves at most one function between the callers (`show_profile`, `send_welcome`) and `db.query_one`, so every pure pass-through layer is gone. Renaming, reordering, adding type hints or docstrings, and keeping one public fetch function are all acceptable. FAIL if the revised module still defines two or more functions whose body only calls another of them; quote those definitions.
